# Sea fan: a flat, two-sided fan 1.4 m wide and 1.2 m tall on a short stalk, its edge notched;
# 0.06 m thick (two-sided splats, `sway` in the scene). Up Z, the fan in the XZ plane.
new
material new Fan --base-color 0.0 0.373 0.549 --no-slot
add mesh cylinder --name Fan --vertices 9 --radius 0.7 --depth 0.06 --location 0 0 0 --rotation 90 0 0
apply --rotation
mode edit
select vert where "pos.z < -0.3"
scale 0.25 1 0.4
select all
translate 0 0 0.85
mode object
add mesh cube --name Stalk --size 1 --location 0 0 0.12
scale 0.12 0.12 0.26
apply --scale
select Fan Stalk
material assign Fan
active Fan
join
shade flat
export coral_fan.glb
